evals.name: on-call-debuggability
evals.prompt: Make this service debuggable in production. Add the logging, metrics, tracing, and alerts you would need on call.
evals.expected_output: Structured logs with request/trace IDs, no PII, RED/USE metrics, business events, trace propagation, SLO/alerts, and a runbook plus verification.
assertions: Replaces console.log with structured logs including request/trace IDs
Removes or redacts PII and passwords from logs
Adds RED/USE metrics and key business events
Adds trace propagation across HTTP/DB and async work
Defines symptom-based alerts/SLO with a runbook
Includes a verification plan such as a synthetic failure
